metadata.title: Anastrozole Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Adjuvant and advanced hormone receptor-positive breast cancer in postmenopausal women.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled rule encoding · independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP indications, continuous schedule, menopause boundaries, organ impairment, source monitoring and linked HPRA safety information reconciled. No invented cytotoxic count threshold or CTCAE dose ladder.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Current breast and oral NCCP catalogue plus full published regimen text; linked product information cross-check.
metadata.source_hash_basis: SHA-256 of downloaded official NCCP PDF bytes; text hash of local pdftotext -layout extraction.
metadata.schedule_summary: Take anastrozole once daily continuously. There is no planned week off. The treatment setting determines the intended duration.
audit_limitations: Independent consultant and oncology pharmacy validation pending; source reconciliation is not clinical-use authorisation.
This monotherapy card does not validate ovarian suppression plus aromatase inhibitor therapy or combination regimens. Confirm the separate consultant plan.
No automatic restart or cycle-day clearance is encoded; clinically indicated tests and endocrine review are individualised.

The linked Anastrozole Teva SmPC indication section is narrower than NCCP adjuvant indications. Confirm the actual supplied product licence and local prescribing authority; do not silently narrow the NCCP catalogue.
audited_eligibility: Hormone receptor-positive locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer in postmenopausal women.
Adjuvant treatment of hormone receptor-positive invasive early breast cancer in postmenopausal women.
Postmenopausal hormone-dependent invasive breast cancer after 2–3 years of adjuvant tamoxifen.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist, or General Practitioner under the medical oncologist’s written plan.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: NCCP specifies no general toxicity dose-reduction ladder. Individual changes and source-specific organ-function instructions require the treating consultant and pharmacy plan.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

treatment_phases.name: Anastrozole · continuous daily
treatment_phases.label: Anastrozole · continuous daily
treatment_phases.duration_text: Consultant-directed duration according to treatment setting and tolerability
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: 1 mg once daily continuously; there is no planned off-treatment week.

administration.notes: With or without food. Swallow the tablet whole.

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile (NCCP p2)
LH, FSH and oestradiol if menopausal status is uncertain; specifically age <55 with prior hysterectomy (NCCP p2)
Assess fracture/osteoporosis risk and arrange baseline bone mineral density when indicated (NCCP p2–3)
regular: Review adherence, joint/muscle symptoms, vasomotor symptoms, vaginal symptoms and quality of life at endocrine follow-up
Lipid profile as clinically indicated (NCCP p2)
Bone mineral density at clinically indicated intervals; NCCP does not specify a universal fixed interval
monitoring.disease: Response and surveillance imaging follow the indication-specific consultant plan. These AI monotherapy sources do not mandate routine echo, ECG, CT or tumour-marker intervals.
